messages:
maya-cs: Hey @alejandro-eng @jin-support — onboarding for Clearway (acct: cw-prod) is hitting intermittent 429s during SDK init. They spun up ~100 parallel clients from a starter script. Error shows "preflight: 429 RATE_LIMIT". Started at 2026-03-23T17:23:20Z. Any quick mitigations? We need to unblock go-live today.

alejandro-eng: What SDK version and how are they authenticating? Ephemeral tokens? Can you dump the raw request headers (sanitized) and any x-rate-limit-* values? Also check whether preflight is running per connection instead of per process.

maya-cs: Using js-sdk v0.10.2, ephemeral tokens via their auth service. Sanitized log snippet: 
```
[17:23:14] init: preflight start
[17:23:14] token fetch -> 200 (latency 120ms)
[17:23:15] preflight -> 429 (x-rate-limit-reset: 165)
[17:23:15] retry (no jitter) -> 429
```
No x-retry-after header, x-rate-limit-remaining = 0.

jin-support: Two likely causes: client-side fanout + token stampede. Quick mitigation: throttle parallel preflights and add jitter. In their js-sdk set: 
```
SDK_INIT_CONCURRENCY=4
PREFLIGHT_JITTER_MS=300-800
PARALLEL_PREFLIGHT=false
```
Also make sure the clock on their auth server is within ~60s of NTP — skew can amplify token churn.

alejandro-eng: Also confirm they're not re-fetching ephemeral tokens per request — that creates a stampede. Short-term workaround: reuse tokens in a connection pool on their side (e.g., INIT_CONN_BUDGET=20, TOKEN_REUSE_MS=30000). I'll ping @ops to temporarily raise their burst allowance for onboarding.

maya-cs: Booking a 1pm PT session with Clearway for the change window. They're happy to try the concurrency tweak first. I'll update here after the meeting. :pray: 

jin-support: I'll run a quick replay of their starter script against a local token-proxy and report back in ~25m. If it still fails we'll ask ops to add a temporary burst and I'll write a short playbook snippet for docs (prefetch splay + token reuse). :thumbsup:
